ctbids-48681-5676973.description:
Worn and appreciated by Warren Winiarski is this elegant Jaeger-LeCoultre Master Control 1000 Hours wristwatch showcasing the exceptional craftsmanship and timeless sophistication of one of Switzerland’s most prestigious luxury watchmakers.
Crafted in 18K solid gold, this distinguished timepiece features a silver-toned dial with gold-tone hands and hour markers, a day/night indicator, subsidiary seconds dial, and date display.
The transparent exhibition case back reveals the beautifully decorated Swiss automatic movement, engraved “Jaeger-LeCoultre Master Control 1000 Hours.
Highlights:
* 18K solid gold case, stamped 750
* Swiss automatic mechanical movement
* Silver-toned dial with gold accents
* Day/night indicator, subsidiary seconds, and date display
* Exhibition caseback showcasing the movement
* Black leather strap
* Reference number appears to be 147.2.05.S (unverified)
* Swiss Made
Condition: Pre-owned with visible surface scratches and signs of age and use on the gold case. Leather strap shows wear. The hands can be manually adjusted using the crown. However, they do not appear to advance over time. Movement is not functioning properly and may require professional servicing or restoring. Service history is unknown. Sold AS-IS. Please review photographs

282598357.description:
Selected Imported Briar
Carved Wooden Tobacco Smoking Pipe
Briar Wood, Ebonite Stem, Approximately 5.8 Inches Long
Classic estate smoking pipe crafted from imported briar wood, featuring decorative diagonal carved fluting across the bowl and distinct stamping along the shank. Briar root has long been the premier choice for traditional tobacco pipes due to its natural flame resistance, moisture absorption, and fine grain pattern. Mid-century estate pipes marked with the heraldic lion shield emblem and "Selected Imported Briar" stamping remain sought-after pieces for vintage tobacciana enthusiasts and collectors.
Shank stamped with heraldic lion in shield emblem and "SELECTED IMPORTED BRIAR"
Warm brown polished briar bowl with diagonal spiral carved grooves
Straight black tapered stem with bright metal trim ring at the shank junction
Measures approximately 5.8 inches long with a 1.2-inch bowl height
Condition:
Estate pre-owned condition. Briar finish shows light handling marks and surface wear consistent with age. Shank stamping is clear and legible. Chamber interior displays typical light carbonization from previous use. Stem fits snugly at the mortise with no cracks, chips, or structural repairs observed.

Polished Gemstone & Crystal Collection

Ideal for geological study, home decor, or as a foundational set for mineral collectors.
Large quartz crystal cluster with visible prismatic terminations
Satin spar (selenite) wand with characteristic fibrous silky luster
Clear faceted quartz crystal point
Assortment of approximately 15 polished tumbled stones in various sizes and colors
